Subject: Ava Health — launch huddle cadence & bridge rotation

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for committing to an initial launch huddle so we can align stakeholders and get the implementation runway scheduled. To keep this lean and practical, proposing a 45-minute "launch huddle" focused on: attendee roles, success criteria (MVP), meeting bridges, and first 30/60/90-day milestones.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Jan 20, 11:00–11:45 AM PST
- Thu Jan 21, 09:00–09:45 AM PST
- Fri Jan 22, 02:00–02:45 PM PST

Please let me know what works for your team and who from Ava will attend (PM, IT/security, integration lead). We typically rotate host responsibilities between Redwood CS/SE for the first three sessions — happy to own the initial meeting.

I've attached a short pre-kickoff checklist and a rough MVP implementation plan so folks can scan ahead. If any regulatory folks need to join, flag me and we can add a secure dial-in.

Cheers,

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

Attachments: pre-kickoff-checklist.pdf; MVP-implementation-plan.xlsx

Thanks Rishi — we can do something this week. Quick notes on attendees and constraints:

- Attendees (confirmed so far): Jordan Mills (PM), Ava Ops: Priya Kumar (integration lead), Dr. Eli Torres (clinical sponsor - calls in on US Eastern), and our InfoSec lead Samir Patel (may be on for first 20 minutes).
- Time constraints: Dr. Torres is only available before 2pm EST (that rules out late PST slots). East coast early mornings are best for our leadership.
- Prefer agenda: 30 minutes of alignment + 15 minutes for action items and next steps. Please include a short slide or doc for integration touchpoints (API, expected throughput, data residency).

Available windows (EST) this week:
- Wed Jan 20: 2:00–2:45 PM EST (which is 11:00–11:45 AM PST) — works for us
- Thu Jan 21: not available morning
- Fri Jan 22: 5:00–5:45 PM EST (late for your team likely)

So Wed Jan 20 11:00 PST looks best. Can you send a calendar invite and confirm dial-in + host rotation? Also, please share the short integration checklist (we'll forward to Priya).

- Session 1 (Jan 20): Redwood CS (Rishi) — run agenda, introductions, outcomes
- Session 2 (Week 2): Redwood SE (Ben) — deep dive integration touchpoints + API playbook
- Session 3 (Week 4): Joint run / Ava Ops lead to present early telemetry

1) 0–5 min — Introductions & success criteria (Rishi)
2) 5–20 min — Integration scope & responsibilities (Ben / Priya)
3) 20–30 min — Security/compliance check (Samir + Redwood security brief)
4) 30–40 min — Delivery milestones (30/60/90) & owners
5) 40–45 min — Action items & next steps (Rishi)

I'll attach the pre-kickoff checklist to the invite and include a Google Drive link to the MVP plan. Rishi — can you confirm who from Redwood will present the integration API endpoints so I can list names?
